regions.region: page 1 title, abstract, author block, and ESI footnote
regions.finding: Article identity and aggregate iodofluorination claim were inspected. The footnote states ESI availability, but source_mapping.json marks SI association unestablished; no SI file or SI-only facts were imported.

regions.region: page 1 center-right Scheme 1 and surrounding prior-work discussion
regions.finding: Three generic monofluorination classes (metal-mediated R–M–F, electrophilic F+, and metal-free R+/F−) were classified as one general overview. The cited literature examples and aggregate reagent discussions were not misclassified as current-paper preparative experiments.

regions.region: page 1 lower-right Table S1 optimization narrative
regions.finding: Twelve explicitly referenced Table S1 rows were retained from the main-text evidence: four fluoride-source failures, Py·9HF entry 5 (53%, 88:8:4), standard Et3N·3HF entry 6 linked to page-2 eqn (1), three increased-loading rows, two lower-temperature/slower-conversion rows, and one room-temperature/selectivity row. Unprinted SI values remain missing.

regions.region: page 1 bottom-right start of Table S2 solvent narrative
regions.finding: The anhydrous-DMF no-reaction row and the beginning of the trace-product solvent discussion were retained; the cross-page continuation is linked to page 2 rather than duplicated.

unresolved: Table S1 and Table S2 are not supplied or associated; exact row quantities, temperatures, times, yields, conversions, and analytical bases absent from the main text remain missing.
Prior-work discussion is aggregate and does not uniquely map every substrate, condition, and outcome to an individual experiment on this page.

regions.region: page 2 upper-left continuation of Table S2 solvent narrative
regions.finding: Rows 2–5 give trace fluorinated products by 1H/19F NMR; CH3CN gives 23% combined yield and 90:9:1 ratio; CH3NO2 gives almost no improvement; DCM and CHCl3 are qualitatively similar to DCE. Only these main-text facts were structured.
Table S1 entry 6 and eqn (1) were merged as one standard-condition experiment: 1a/NIS 1.5 equiv/Et3N·3HF 1.0 equiv/anhydrous DCE, 0 °C, 15 h, 58% NMR combined yield, 2a:(Z)-3a:(E)-3a = 87:11:2.

regions.region: page 2 lower-left Table 1 reaction header, rows 1–15, and footnotes a–h
regions.finding: All fifteen scope rows were retained independently with R1/R2 labels, row times, product-2 yields, crude-19F-NMR 2:3 ratios, 6 mmol overrides, Py·9HF overrides, crude-1H-NMR yield bases, the 9% (Z)-5h byproduct, low-temperature chromatography, and trace HF-elimination products.
Two functionalized-allene arrows were retained separately: 1n gives 2n (42%) plus (E)-3n (9%), and 1o gives 2o (51%) plus (E)-3o (12%), each with NIS/Et3N·3HF in DCE at 0 °C for 15 h.

Seven distinct arrows/rows were retained: Step A 6 mmol iodofluorination; Step B Suzuki coupling to 6a; Step C base conversion to 4a with a two-step yield from 1a; Step D homologation to 7a; Step E sequential LDA/MOMCl formation of 8a; and two Sonogashira rows 2d→9d and 2g→9g.

unresolved: The main article omits operational workups, purifications, masses, and many yield bases; these remain missing rather than inferred from unassociated SI.
Table 1 product 3 is reported as an aggregate regioisomer class; separate Z/E amounts are not provided for the scope rows.
Compact 1o/2o/3o side-chain structures and all stereochemical encodings require expert review.

regions.region: page 3 upper-left continuation of Scheme 3 discussion
regions.finding: The prose confirms Step C as 51% combined isolated yield over Steps A+C from 1a, identifies 7a and 8a conversions, and names the 9d/9g Sonogashira applications. These statements were merged with page-2 arrows and not duplicated.

Conclusion summarizes the method without adding a new experiment. The statement that Table 1 entries 4, 6, and 14 were reproduced by Mr Chen Bo was linked to those existing records; it supplies no independent condition set or outcome and creates no duplicate experiments.

Bibliography and prior-literature citations only. External papers were not expanded into experiments of the current article, and no current-paper reaction arrow, table row, or procedure is present in this region.

unresolved: The reproduction acknowledgement has no independent quantities, conditions, analytical data, or run identifier.
References 32–35 identify literature methods used in Scheme 3 but do not provide missing current-run operations in this paper.
No Supporting Information association is established; no SI facts were imported or inferred.
